content.short: KwikClaim uses AI to help users find unclaimed airdrops, rewards, mints, renewals, and votes across chains.
content.description: KwikClaim helps you uncover unclaimed crypto opportunities across multiple networks, including Ethereum, Solana, Starknet, and SUI, as well as other supported chains. It identifies airdrops, rewards, mints, renewals, and votes you may have missed, making it easy to discover forgotten rewards. Its AI-powered system explains why a wallet may be eligible, giving clear, actionable reasoning for each opportunity. You can browse by chain or category and get real-time updates, helping you prioritize claims and maximize unseen value across ecosystems.
content.meta: KwikClaim helps users find unclaimed crypto like airdrops, rewards, and mints across chains. Discover KwikClaim and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
